text_block_list.text:
The trial of Biwa Hayahide's new<n>equation focused
on winning—rather<n>than simply not losing—proves to
be a<n>success, and she claims victory at the<n>Kikuka
Sho.

Biwa Hayahide is too happy to hide<n>her joy, and
when Narita Taishin<n>comes to challenge her to a
rematch,<n>she is shocked by her friend's<n>unexpected
exuberance.

They promise to run together again at<n>the spring
Tenno Sho, and Biwa<n>Hayahide pronounces her
certain<n>victory with a huge smile.
